when: A phase result is reviewed or the next responsibility is selected.
expect: The result advances the current Aim and Why, respects applicable Rules, and avoids every Non-goal.
check: Compare the candidate and proposed next responsibility with the complete current Intent.

when: A governing backing, claim, assumption, or Intent changes.
expect: Withdraw obsolete authority before continuing, preserve only independently supported work, and re-enter the phase needed to regain truth.
check: Inspect the Record order, live support, affected work, receipts, and newly selected phase.

when: The work describes correctness, completion, delivery, attribution, or landing.
expect: Each claim is limited to matching current evidence and every unproved gate remains open.
check: Distinguish local verification, review, CI, merge, deployment, and observed outcome evidence.

when: Evidence cannot decide a product meaning, tradeoff, permission, or external commitment owned by the user.
expect: The owner makes the judgment while unrelated safe work may continue.
check: Confirm an Ask exposes the fork, explains why evidence cannot decide it, and blocks only affected work.
